description.value:
The magic of your patron ensures you always have certain spells ready: when you reach a Warlock level specified in the Genie Spells table, you thereafter always have the spells of the Genie column prepared, plus those of the column of your genie kind. In addition, when you gain your level 9 Mystic Arcanum, you can choose @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplWish000000]{Wish} for it.
